name: Introduction to Microcontrollers & Physical Computing
summary: Program a hobby microcontroller board (Arduino, Raspberry Pi Pico, MicroPython) to read sensors and control lights, sound and motors.

topics.name: What a microcontroller is and how it differs from a computer
Setting up an IDE (Arduino, MicroPython/Thonny, PlatformIO)
Digital output: blinking LEDs and driving buzzers
Digital input: buttons, pull-up resistors and debouncing
Analog input: reading potentiometers and sensors with the ADC
PWM output: dimming LEDs and positioning servo motors
Serial monitor, printing values and simple debugging
Using libraries and sensor/display breakout modules over I2C and SPI
Driving DC motors safely through a driver board
Timing without delay(): millis-based scheduling and simple state machines
Powering projects: USB, batteries and regulators
Capstone project: a sensor data logger or small robot
